subject: design/execution-demand-contract-v1
statement: A single pure Go evaluator consumes the closed assessment and immutable `execution-demand-policy/v1` data, takes the componentwise maximum of every applicable floor, applies named interaction promotions, and then applies a cited assurance raise. The planner authors only the assessment, citations, and optional assurance raise. Plangate alone calls the evaluator to materialize the four minima into the generated plan face and canonical capsule, then verifies those bytes before checkpoint and freeze. An authoring UI may preview evaluator output, but that preview is non-authoritative and never becomes a planner-authored profile accepted by the gate.
